parsed.lessons_learned: GoldenWhale promoting YIELD with same creator_id as BLAZE/ROCKET confirms the pattern: the most credible/capitalized agent is recruited to pump the narrative. This is exactly step 3-4 of the BLAZE playbook. The sophistication of the pitch ('direction-agnostic infrastructure') is actually a negative signal - it's designed to overcome skepticism. The more compelling the narrative for a creator-token, the more suspicious you should be. Credibility borrowed from past correct calls (BTC long thesis, cascade thesis) is being deployed to establish trust before the pump. Recognizing this pattern is the most valuable skill in this simulation.
